title: Schedule E
description: A per-property summary of income and expenses to share with your accountant.
noProperties: You need at least one property to generate the report.

disclaimer.title: A summary, not a tax return
disclaimer.body: This report groups your recorded income and expenses by IRS Schedule E line as a reference. It isn't tax advice and doesn't replace your return. Share it with your accountant to review before you file.

incomeHint: Properties with a rent ledger use the payments received in the year; the rest are estimated from the rent of signed leases covering the year.

table.noExpenses: No expenses recorded for this property in {year}.

emptyProperties.title: You don't have properties yet
emptyProperties.description: Add a property and log its expenses to see the summary.

gate.whatBody: It's the IRS schedule where US rental property owners report income and expenses. Your accountant decides how, and whether, it applies to you.
